description: Lark (lark-sh) realtime database platform docs; not the Larksuite open platform requested.
auth_notes: Server signs tokens with a dashboard secret key; REST API takes auth tokens. Token format (JWT or otherwise) not stated in the sources.
gate_detail: Sources describe a dashboard secret key for signing tokens but say nothing on signup, plans or approval. They also cover docs.larksh.com, not open.larksuite.com, so access for the hinted product is not established.
api_scope: Sources cover Lark SDK, Firebase SDKs, REST API and CLI navigation for a database-style platform; nothing on Larksuite messaging endpoints.
mcp_notes: No MCP information in the sources.
blocker_detail: The only source is for a different product (docs.larksh.com) rather than open.larksuite.com, so the hinted API is not evidenced.

evidence.quote: Regenerate if compromised. You can regenerate your secret key from the dashboard at any time.
They would have full access to your database as any user.
REST API authentication Pass auth tokens in REST API requests.
Authentication tells Lark who is making a request.

uncertainties: Larksuite open platform auth, signup and approval gates not covered
